description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving employee leave data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing employee leaves with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and sets up validation rules for request parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for listing employee leave records, applying filters, sorting, validation, and handling unimplemented CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of employee leaves, returning the data along with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the parameters accepted by the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws an exception as creating employee leaves via this API is not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws an exception as create operation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws an exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws an exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the default value for the 'includeEmployees' filter parameter.

methods.name: getDefaultStatuses
methods.description: Returns the default statuses filter for pending leave requests.
